messages:
Tessa (CSM): Hi team — kickoff for Meridian Clinic onboarding. Goal: staging integration + 25 clinician pilot in 28 days. Need owners for infra, metrics, enablement, compliance. Flag major blockers here.

Arjun (Success Ops): High-level signals: DAU >= 10 in pilot, errors < 2%, median latency < 300ms. Renewal watch if DAU < 6 at day 45. Recommend in-app thumbs + weekly micro-survey.

Marta (Solutions Eng): I'll take infra/integration. Need sanitized sample notes and a staging key. Plan: smoke test day 2, e2e by day 7. Do we want streaming responses for triage?

Ben (Product): Start non-streaming for pilot for stable evaluation. We'll define 3 acceptance flows: summary, triage suggestion, and embedding search. I'll post expected outputs.

Renee (Enablement): I'll run two sessions: quick dev walkthrough (20m) and admin ops (30m). Dev on day 3, admin on day 9. I'll prepare a 1-pager and example prompts.

Tessa (CSM): Owners: infra = Marta, metrics = Arjun, enablement = Renee, product sign-off = Ben. I'll update the board and schedule weekly 30-min sync.

ConfigBot: staging-key: MERIDIAN_STG_42 provisioned. Logs retention = 90 days (sanitization flag ON).

Marta (Solutions Eng): Thanks. Will run smoke test tomorrow morning and report results. Need the sample notes link from Tessa.

Arjun (Success Ops): I'll create the pulse survey and dashboard tiles by day 4. Also will capture failure modes — Tessa, can you request 5 common failure examples from Meridian?

Tessa (CSM): On it — asking Meridian for 10 anonymized examples + 5 failure cases.

Ben (Product): Quick question: pilot model variant — recommend quantized for cost controls, escalate to larger as needed. Agree?

Renee (Enablement): Agree. I'll craft training notes tuned to the quantized model's output tendencies.

Marta (Solutions Eng): Action items recap: Marta — smoke test D2 + e2e D7; Arjun — dashboard + survey D4; Renee — docs + sessions; Ben — acceptance flows. Ack with ETA.

Marta (Solutions Eng): Ack — smoke test by 1801310000, e2e by 1801670000.

Arjun (Success Ops): Ack — dashboard + survey by day 4.

Renee (Enablement): Ack — docs draft by day 3, sessions added to calendar.

Tessa (CSM): Thanks all. I'll monitor adoption metrics and post board link when ready. Closing kickoff thread; ping here for blockers. :rocket:
